lawRefs: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code 17041 (rates, annual CCPI indexing)
Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code 17043 (1% Behavioral Health Services Tax, formerly Mental Health Services Tax, on taxable income over $1,000,000)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Hand-transcribed from the fetched source documents; sha256 (when filled) is of the canonical body. Brackets are the FTB '2026 California Tax Rate Schedules' (Schedules X, Y, Z); standard deduction and exemption credits are from FTB Tax News October 2026, '2026 Indexing' (https://www.ftb.ca.gov/about-ftb/newsroom/tax-news/2026/10.html; CCPI June 2025 to June 2026 = 3.4%). The 2026 Form 540-ES instructions still print 2025 amounts ($5,706 / $11,412) because they predate indexing; do not use them. MFS uses Schedule X (single); qualifying surviving spouse uses Schedule Y. The 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax on taxable income over $1,000,000 is in `surtax`; that threshold is not indexed and is the same $1,000,000 for every filing status (not doubled for MFJ). personalExemptionCredit is $158 per filer ($316 joint); filers 65+ and blind filers each get an additional $158 credit (a credit, so seniorExtraDeduction is 0); the dependent credit is $491. Exemption credits phase out at high federal AGI (indexed thresholds, not captured here). California starts from federal AGI with Schedule CA adjustments, fully exempts Social Security, has no general pension/IRA exclusion, and taxes capital gains as ordinary income. Not modeled: California AMT, SDI payroll tax, renter's credit, 2.5% additional tax on early retirement distributions.

flags.seniorExtraDeduction: 0 because the 65+ benefit is an extra $158 exemption credit, not a deduction
flags.personalExemptionCredit: phases out at high federal AGI; 2026 phase-out thresholds not captured
flags.surtax: threshold fixed at $1,000,000 for all filing statuses, not indexed
